full_name: Christina Warinner | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2023–2024 Social Sciences Sally Starling Seaver Associate Professor Harvard University
bio: Christina Warinner, the Sally Starling Seaver Associate Professor at Radcliffe and a John L. Loeb Associate Professor of the Social Sciences in the Harvard Faculty of Arts and Sciences, has conducted groundbreaking studies on the evolution and changing ecology of the human microbiome and published extensively on prehistoric migrations, the origins and spread of dairy pastoralism, and the biodiversity of the human gut microbiome.
